title: Weekend Crypto Volatility and Monday Market Risk
abstract: arXiv:2610.35702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cryptocurrencies trade continuously while major traditional markets close over the weekend. We examine whether weekend cryptocurrency volatility predicts Monday variance in equity, commodity and fixed-income markets. Using daily range-based variance measures for Bitcoin, Ether, XRP, the S&P 500, gold and a US Treasury ETF over 2017-2026, we augment heterogeneous autoregressive models with a common weekend cryptocurrency factor. Predictive content is weak before 2024 but significant thereafter. In the post-2024 sample, a one-standard-deviation increase in the factor is associated with 27-54% higher fitted Monday variance. Adding the factor reduces out-of-sample QLIKE losses by 11-22%, although statistical evidence varies across markets. Friday cryptocurrency volatility does not reproduce the result, and coin-specific variation adds no significant predictive information beyond the common factor. translated_title: 周末加密货币波动性与周一市场风险
translated_abstract: 加密货币全天候持续交易，而主要传统市场在周末休市。我们研究周末加密货币波动性是否能够预测股票、大宗商品和固定收益市场周一的方差。利用2017-2026年间比特币、以太坊、XRP、标普500指数、黄金和美国国债ETF的日度基于极差的方差度量，我们在异质自回归模型中加入了一个共同的周末加密货币因子。该因子的预测能力在2024年之前较弱，但在此之后表现显著。在2024年之后的样本中，该因子每增加一个标准差，对应的拟合周一方差会提高27-54%。加入该因子可使样本外QLIKE损失降低11-22%，尽管统计证据在不同市场之间有所差异。周五加密货币波动性无法重现这一结果，且在共同因子之外，特定币种的波动变化不提供显著的预测信息。一种内生性方法估计出一个结构断点位于……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心发现是，周末加密货币的共同波动因子自2024年起能够显著预测股票、大宗商品和国债市场周一的风险水平，将一标准差的因子冲击可使周一方差提高27-54%，并使样本外预测损失降低11-22%。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that a common weekend cryptocurrency volatility factor significantly predicts Monday variance in equity, commodity, and fixed-income markets after 2024, with a one-standard-deviation increase associated with 27-54% higher Monday variance and an 11-22% reduction in out-of-sample QLIKE losses.
